text:
**Stop accepting boring, generic text from ChatGPT.**

Add one simple phrase to your prompt to get instant, human-level writing.

How to use it:
• Write your standard prompt as usual.
• Add this line at the end: "Edit this like a strict boss who hates fluff."
• Watch AI cut dead weight and fix the tone instantly.

The bottom line:
What used to take 20 minutes of manual editing now takes 5 seconds.

What is your favorite ChatGPT prompt trick?
